title: Convert HTML file to Next.js components: index.html
description: This comprehensive task list outlines the process of converting a static HTML file (index.html) into a functional Next.js application using TypeScript. It includes setting up a Next.js project, parsing the HTML, converting it to JSX components, extracting and integrating styles, handling assets, and refactoring into reusable components, followed by review and testing.

tasks.title: Initialize Next.js Project
tasks.description: Create a new Next.js project using `create-next-app` with TypeScript in a session-specific output directory. This sets up the foundational structure for the conversion.

file_operations.description: Root directory for the new Next.js project. This will contain all generated project files.
